subject: POC kickoff & hands-on working session — scheduling and timezone coordination
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@aurelius.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Bob Nguyen <bob@aurelius.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T15:12:00-05:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff & hands-on working session — initial timing

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the demo last week. The Aurelius engineering and SRE leads are excited to start the POC and do a hands-on session focused on: prompt review, routing behavior under peak, and a short load test (10k tok/s target burst).

We want to kick off next week with a 90-min working session to walk the team through the prompt templates, routing matrix, and run an initial load test. Proposed windows (all listed with local equivalents):

- Wed Mar 4, 09:00–10:30 PST / 12:00–13:30 EST / 17:00–18:30 CET
- Wed Mar 4, 16:00–17:30 PST / Thu Mar 5, 00:00–01:30 CET (for EMEA overlap)
- Thu Mar 5, 08:00–09:30 HKT / 21:00–22:30 PST (APAC-friendly)

Attendees: Aurelius — Alice (PM), Bob (SRE), Lina Park (NLP lead). Redwood — Jordan, technical lead, + one infra/sre (TBD).

Please confirm availability and whether Redwood needs any pre-shared artifacts (prompt sets, sample traffic, expected peak QPS). I can share a proposed agenda and calendar invite once we lock a slot.

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Chen
Product Manager, Aurelius Financial
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@aurelius.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-01T17:03:00-05:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff & hands-on working session — initial timing

Hi Alice —

Thanks — excited to run this. We can cover: prompt review, routing (policy & fallbacks), KV/prefix caching, and a 30–40 min controlled load run with your SREs.

Quick notes/questions:
- Can you confirm Lina's email so I can add her?
- For the load test: what steady-state QPS and burst QPS should we plan? You mentioned ~10k tokens/sec burst — we usually plan token/sec and concurrent sessions.
- We usually request sample prompt sets + a small CSV of user/session ids to seed the KV cache. If you can drop those in the shared Drive link that’s ideal.

Suggested slots (I'll convert explicitly):
- Wed 2026-03-04 09:00–10:30 PT (12:00–13:30 ET / 17:00–18:30 CET) — good overlap for NA+EU early evening.
- Wed 2026-03-04 16:00–17:30 PT (00:00–01:30 CET next day) — works if EMEA can do late night.
- Thu 2026-03-05 08:00–09:30 HKT (21:00–22:30 PT previous day) — APAC-friendly.

Laura — tagging you for the load-test plan and routing checklist. Vivek — can you confirm who from infra will join for the burst testing?

Attached: poc-agenda.pdf (agenda + ask list); load-test-plan.xlsx (draft).

Cheers,
Jordan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Chen <alice.chen@aurelius.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-01T18:22:00-05:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff & hands-on working session — load test checklist

Jordan / Alice —

I pulled together a short checklist for the burst run (attached load-test-plan.xlsx). Key asks:
- Baseline steady-state (qps) and expected peak token/sec (please provide both).
- Representative prompt set (min 50 prompts with distribution notes).
- Any routing rules we should mirror (e.g., region pinning, model fallbacks).

Also starting a routing-matrix.csv to capture which traffic should route to which model variant during the test — helps us test graceful degradation. I can lead the test but will need an infra contact for instance scaling. Vivek — can you confirm?

Thanks,
Laura
Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Bob Nguyen <bob@aurelius.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Chen <alice.chen@aurelius.com>
Date: 2026-03-02T02:14:00+00:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff & hands-on working session — timing conflict

Hi Jordan —

Thanks — quick note: the Wed 09:00 PT slot conflicts with a leadership sync for our SREs. We can do the Wed 16:00 PT slot, but prefer to shift it 30 minutes later if possible to accommodate another team observer. Alternative proposed slots:

- Wed 2026-03-04 16:30–18:00 PT (00:30–02:00 CET)
- Thu 2026-03-05 08:00–09:30 HKT (21:00–22:30 PT prev day) — this second option is fine for our APAC folks.

If we go with the late Wed option, note that CET folks will be very late — fine for a one-off.

Bob
SRE Manager, Aurelius Financial
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Chen <alice.chen@aurelius.com>, Bob Nguyen <bob@aurelius.com>
Date: 2026-03-02T09:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff & hands-on working session — rotating schedule suggestion

Thanks all —

We can support either Wed late or Thu APAC slot. To make multi-region collaboration smoother, I propose we rotate recurring working sessions across time zones (e.g., first week NA-friendly, second week EMEA-friendly late slot, third week APAC-friendly) so every stakeholder can attend occasionally without night calls every week. For the kickoff: I can have an infra engineer join for the burst test if you confirm the burst profile (tokens/sec + concurrency).

I've created a tentative calendar poll with three options (links below) — please vote availability so we can lock the invite. Also, if you can upload the 50-sample prompts + routing-matrix.csv to the shared Drive before EOD Tue, we'll pre-seed caches.

Calendar poll: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcdef123456
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/pocteamshare

Vivek

Subject: Re: POC kickoff & hands-on working session — confirmed slot & invite

Hi Alice / Bob —

Thanks for the quick responses. Based on votes and availability, we've confirmed:

- Kickoff working session: Wed 2026-03-04 16:30–18:00 PT (00:30–02:00 CET) — one-time kickoff to accommodate NA + late EU observers.

I've sent the calendar invite (see link below) and attached the final agenda and the updated load-test plan. Please accept the invite and add Lina's email so we can share materials.

Quick checklist before the call:
- Aurelius to upload: sample prompts (50+), routing-matrix.csv, and expected burst profile (tokens/sec + concurrent sessions).
- Redwood will pre-seed KV cache using provided session ids and bring infra engineer for scaling.
- We'll record the session and share notes + the raw load test results.
